{"code": "import pandas as pd

# Load the data
df = pd.read_csv('data/sales.csv')

# Check the distribution of customer_age
print(df['customer_age'].value_counts().sort_index())

# Compute mean age, excluding -1 values (invalid/missing)
mean_age = df[df['customer_age'] != -1]['customer_age'].mean()

print(f'Mean age (excluding -1): {mean_age}')"}
